darrow.subtitle: Multi-service Telegram Web App — Taxi, Food Delivery & Handyman Services
darrow.description: Co-developed a Yandex Go-style super-app running inside Telegram's in-app browser. Part of a 3-person remote team (1 backend, 2 frontend). Built booking and ordering flows across 4 service categories, optimized UI for Telegram's constrained WebView, and integrated REST APIs for real-time order processing.
highlights: Architected booking flows for taxi, food delivery, handyman services, and shop orders — all sharing a unified UI component library
Optimized for Telegram WebView limitations: implemented JS-based viewport height calculations where CSS dvh units failed
Integrated REST APIs handling 5,000+ total orders with centralized error handling and loading states

smart_life.subtitle: Full-scale E-Commerce Platform — Live at smartlife.uz
smart_life.description: Built the complete customer-facing storefront for Smart Life, an electronics retailer in Uzbekistan. Solo frontend developer responsible for product catalog, cart system, and checkout — from Figma to production deployment on Next.js.
highlights: Built product catalog with URL-based filtering (shareable/bookmarkable filter states) and debounced search to minimize API calls
Implemented cart and order management with RTK Query — optimistic updates for instant-feeling UI, automatic cache invalidation on mutations
Mobile-first responsive design serving 70%+ mobile users — every component designed at 320px first, then enhanced for desktop
